title: Adsorption performance and mechanisms of ciprofloxacin onto microplastics: effects of different textures and aging degrees
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,1120-1133
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM01033K, Paper
Jian Zhang, Baowei Zhao, Yin Zhang, Fengfeng Ma, Xin Zhang, Hao Zhao
This work provides systematic insights into CIP adsorption onto pristine and aged MPs, offering a foundation for understanding MPs–antibiotic interactions and assessing environmental risks.
